station_quality.comparison: DWD KL daily SDK, provisional 12 km three-nearest-IDW area estimate; NOT independent of DUETT stations

method.observation: DUETT per-hour region means in minutes, accumulated to complete 24-hour UTC days and converted to hours
method.forecast: Hourly sunshine_duration per ensemble member (seconds), 24 hours ending 01:00 through next-day 00:00 UTC (closest to DUETT :50 synoptic hours), converted to hours; area support-point means
method.gap_policy: Missing observed hours or model hours are never counted as zero
method.reference: Climatology 1991-2020 will be added from a separate historical product
